g.text: GALINI / L03 / SEC07 / Salt loft and Customs road
Named encounter section / adjacent architecture, explicit positions and a bounded review question
L

Spatial prediction
The Salt route enters an upper loading room, descends in
two different directions around a +2 turning platform and
emerges beside the Boat approach. Customs is a 5 m-wide
sloped cart road with a +2 turning court; its upper
arrival wraps the East Homes frontage.
Support / opposing response
These connections trade enclosed short-stage clearing
against a longer exposed exterior road. Every
indispensable route is reversible; no drop, boost or jump
is claimed. Both intermediate +2 landings are local
transfers, not a new cross-town level.
Affected: M11, I07, S5a, S5b, L5, R6a, LR6, R6b, D09, D10.
Walk routes: R05, R06, R10. All circles are body centers,
not measured camera poses.

L03 / geometry prediction. Later capture each listed stance from both sides, include the follower, and inspect standing/crouched exposure plus all intermediate stair or ramp
positions. Roofs and slabs remain opaque. Movement openings and observation apertures are different contracts.
